Following ongoing $50 discounts on AirPods Pro and the launch of the all-new Beats 360 earbuds, today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break headline features some solid M5 MacBook Air deals. Amazon has select mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models marked down by $150, while the official Apple Refurbished Store today has 15-inch models discounted by up to $300. Along with the ongoing $240 discount on the most affordable Apple Studio Display, we also have a slew of M4 iPad Air configurations marked down by over $100, hundreds of Amazon Prime Day early bird deals for fall, and plenty more to browse below.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Amazon fall Prime Day early bird deals now live: Apple, Pixel, Anker, $20 off Grubhub, and more

Mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models now $150 off at Amazon

Alongside the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals, Amazon is now giving you a chance to pick up a mid-tier 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with $150 off.

Amazon is currently selling a 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and an upgraded 1TB of storage for $1,449 with free shipping.

This configuration regularly sells for $1,599, and with $150 off, it's one of the best prices we've seen since prices went up a few months ago. While not every color is discounted to this price right now, you can land this deal on the classic Silver, Sky Blue, and Starlight models.

When it comes to the M5 MacBook Air lineup at this price tier, any model with $150 off is a solid deal. While $100 off configurations aren't bad either, we'd really like to be in the $150 range, especially for any upgraded configurations.

The base configuration doesn't have much to write home about right now, but Amazon also has the 13-inch model with 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,649 with free shipping — also $150 off.

M5 MacBook Air 15-inch models now up to $300 off at the official Apple Refurbished Store

While we've tracked $150 discounts on brand-new 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models at Amazon today, the official Apple Refurbished Store also has some solid deals on the 15-inch models if you act fast — discounts of up to $300 right now. Details below.

Head to this page, select MacBook Air on the left — that will display all in-stock M5 models you can grab at a discount right away.

That said, the real highlights here — while supplies last — are the entry-level 15-inch and 24GB/1TB models, discounted by $230 and $300, respectively:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • Midnight, Silver, Starlight, Sky Blue
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, Sky Blue

Here's the rundown on the official Apple Refurbished Store offerings:

  • Undergoes rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • Backed by Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Backed by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrapping are not available for refurbished products
  • Supplies are limited

Apple's most affordable M4 iPad Air configurations are $100 off, with the 1TB model now $150 off

Amazon is now offering a range of M4 iPad Air configurations with $100 off. This includes the most affordable 11-inch and 13-inch models, as well as the 1TB version with $150 off.

While inventory seems thin for some color options enjoying the discount, you can find a range of configurations with at least $100 off as of writing.

Today's deals are largely in line with the discounts on the most affordable models that have been easiest to grab since the price increase — keep an eye out for that 1TB version you can now grab for $150 off:

11-inch M4 iPad Air

  • M4 iPad Air 256GB $749 (originally $849)
  • M4 iPad Air 512GB $949 (originally $1,049)

Official Apple Refurbished Store's most affordable 2026 Studio Display is $240 off while supplies last

We've seen quite a few notable deals on the 2026 Apple Studio Display at Amazon over the past few weeks, but the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store now has a rare discount on the most affordable model — $240 off.

The official Apple Refurbished Store is currently selling the 2026 Apple Studio Display with a tilt-adjustable stand for $1,359 with free shipping.
